dedupe_keys.name: rbsm residential building stock model for a carbon neutral swiss building stock

description: RBSM is the Python code and data behind the paper Pathways toward a carbon-neutral Swiss residential building stock by Marta Roca-Puigròs, Romain Guillaume Billy, Andreas Gerber, Patrick Wäger and Daniel Beat Müller in the journal Buildings and Cities. It adapts the ODYM dynamic material flow library to model the Swiss residential stock by cohort; a main file sets the scenarios, the emission accounting method and the energy definition, and further files plot and export results to xlsx or csv. The repository also holds a simplified model of a combined lifetime-leaching approach with fictional example data. Coverage: Switzerland, residential buildings. Access: free code and data on GitLab. Licence: GPL-3.0-only for code, CC BY-NC-SA for data. Caveats: pinned to Python 3.6 and old package versions; last commit August 2020. Simulation uses are long-run stock, material and emission scenarios for renovation and replacement policies. Related records: the Gothenburg construction and demolition material flow model on CoMSES.
inputs: Swiss residential building stock by cohort
Scenarios of renovation, construction and energy supply
name: RBSM: Residential Building Stock Model for a carbon-neutral Swiss building stock
